svg.title: Tesseract verification oracle chain
svg.desc: References (ggml CPU backend, libtsr_ref, numpy spec model) check the ISA simulator and the ggml-tesseract backend on TSR_DEVICE=sim through test-backend-ops, klcheck and numcheck. tsr-trace-gen and TSR_TRACE dumps make trace sets whose results come from the simulator; the RTL replays them bit-exactly in cocotb + Verilator and fastreplay, mutation campaigns check those tests, and the U200 hardware will replay the same traces once the card is installed.
